name: create or destroy water
lore:
# On the Transmutation of Aquas: Create or Destroy Water

To the uninitiated, this spell is a mere utility; to the seasoned wayfarer, it is the difference between life and a dusty grave. When manifesting, the air thickens with a sudden, localized humidity as sapphire sparks coalesce into a pure, crystalline deluge. Conversely, to destroy is to witness a silent, violent evaporation—a parched void where liquid once shimmered.

Shaping the Weave for this rite feels like wringing a heavy, invisible sponge. One must grasp the ambient moisture of the Aether, pulling with a rhythmic, pulsing pressure until the barrier between planes thins. It is a tactile magic, smelling of petrichor and ancient ozone.

Scholars trace its origin to the "Thirsting Sage" of the Gilded Wastes. Legend claims Elian the Wanderer spent forty days adrift in a sea of salt. On the brink of death, he did not pray for mercy but commanded the very atoms of the dry air to weep. His desperate demand tore the first gallon of conjured rain from a cloudless sky, birthing this essential art.
